title: Service Request Envelope
description: Common request envelope for all SITEBORNE service invocations. Wraps service-specific input payload.

request_id.description: Unique request identifier. Must be a valid UUID v4 or ULID.

service_id.description: Canonical service identifier. Must match the target service schema.

service_version.description: Explicit service version. Must match the service schema version.

response_schema_version.description: Expected output schema version. Allows forward-compatible evolution.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated idempotency key for exactly-once semantics. Required for paid operations.

freshness_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable age of cached data in seconds. 0 = no cache. Bounded to prevent stale data.

minimum_verification_score.description: Minimum PCC verification score required for the result to be accepted. Range [0, 1].

maximum_authorized_price.description: Maximum price the caller authorizes for this request. Required for paid services.

buyer_metadata.description: Optional buyer-provided metadata that cannot alter execution policy, pricing, or security constraints.

input.description: Service-specific input payload. Schema determined by service_id.

extensions.description: Reverse-domain qualified extensions per PCC 1.0.0 rules.
